G001.target_statement: Recommend news that matches my interests and reading behaviour, delivered through search-page recommendations and app notifications.
G001.label: direct
G001.rationale: 原文多处明确表达：搜索页推荐按搜索与行为定制是“great experience”，跟踪习惯并展示感兴趣的新闻是优点，基于习惯与兴趣的推荐是选择平台的关键因素，故个体化推荐为明确意图。

G002.target_statement: Deliver news of an event within a couple of days of it happening.
G002.label: direct
G002.rationale: 原文以“I would like to get the news of the event in a couple of days itself”直接表达时效愿望，并以两周前的 F1 新闻无意义为例；数量词“a couple of days”按原话保留，未另设阈值。

G003.target_statement: Show which publication each story comes from.
G003.label: direct
G003.rationale: 原文明确说明“all of the sources are cited”，并以此作为可信度最佳的理由，属于对既有能力的明确肯定与维持意图；目标只保留“显示来源”这一项，未扩展为事实核查机制。

G004.target_statement: Let me compare the same story across multiple sources, including differing opinions.
G004.label: direct
G004.rationale: 原文说明多来源展示使其“不只看到一个来源、不只看到一面”，并描述自己把同一条新闻再搜索以查看相似或不同意见，另有明确的比较维度（长度、时效、立场）；合并为跨来源比较意图。

G005.target_statement: Curate news notifications so that they do not spam me and important news is not missed.
G005.label: direct
G005.rationale: 原文把通知过载称为挑战，并在后续明确“通知不应被刷屏，因为会导致错过重要新闻”，故通知量控制有直接依据；具体限额原文未给，未编造。

G006.target_statement: Provide shorter article content that still covers every aspect of the event.
G006.label: direct
G006.rationale: 原文既抱怨千字长文在有限时间内效率低、希望有更小的内容快速跟上，又在理想体验中要求“small but comprehensive”，两项合为一个核心动作：给出更短但仍覆盖全面的内容；“some of the articles”的范围限定保留在 context。

G007.target_statement: Serve news pages without ads, so ads do not cover the article content.
G007.label: direct
G007.rationale: 原文以理想阅读体验的形式直接表达“新闻页面没有广告”，并说明广告会遮盖内容导致难以阅读；属于明确的质量/避免型目标，未扩展为商业模式结论。

G008.target_statement: Compose notifications with the headline, the article image on the left, and a few words of the preface.
G008.label: direct
G008.rationale: 原文明确给出通知内容与布局：标题为主、图片置于左侧、标题在上，并加入几句导语以引起兴趣；情态词“can be / would be great”保留在 context，未升格为强制。

G009.target_statement: Share an article directly to WhatsApp by opening the WhatsApp share link automatically.
G009.label: direct
G009.rationale: 原文把直接分享并自动打开 WhatsApp 称为最佳分享方式，属于明确选定的方式；复制链接的现状作为背景保留在 context，未另立目标。

G010.target_statement: Let me define my own topic buckets, add multiple articles to them, and open a bucket to read its articles later.
G010.label: direct
G010.rationale: 原文以“would love to have”明确要求自定义 topic bucket：自行定义、把多篇文章加入、之后按主题集中阅读；三者是同一功能的核心动作与预期结果，未拆分。

G011.target_statement: Do not push an agenda or propaganda at me through automated curation or through my reading data.
G011.label: direct
G011.rationale: 原文先表达对自动化新闻策展的严重担忧（知道兴趣后可能推送议程），后以“should not be able to use this data to push some agenda / propaganda”明确否定性要求；两条同一结果（不被推送议程）合并，通道分别记入 context。

G012.target_statement: Deliver all of the day's breaking news by the end of the day.
G012.label: direct
G012.rationale: 原文以“should at least ... by the end of the day”直接给出数量（当天全部）、时间（当天结束前）与最低强度（at least），并明确反对四天后才给；要素照录。

G013.target_statement: Let me disable a topic, while still showing breaking news on that topic and hiding its in-depth articles.
G013.label: direct
G013.rationale: 原文提出应有“disable the topic”功能，并立即给出 caveat：该话题若有突发新闻仍要展示，但不要深度分析；例外与否定都在同一目标中保留，未拆成两个目标以免丢失例外关系。

G014.target_statement: Make navigation from the homepage to an article and on to related or similar articles clear, without confusion.
G014.label: direct
G014.rationale: 原文把导航列为选择平台的重要因素，并给出路径（首页—文章—相关文章），同时明确“不应在导航时感到困惑”；困惑作为负面结果保留在目标内。

G015.target_statement: Keep the interface intuitive so that common actions need no figuring out.
G015.label: direct
G015.rationale: 原文明确把易用性/直观性列为选择平台的因素，并说明若不直观就会改用别的平台；目标保留“无需思考即可完成操作”的表述，未虚构具体交互细节。

G016.target_statement: Store only limited reading data and use it only for recommendations.
G016.label: direct
G016.rationale: 原文明确否定“存储我看过的全部数据”，并把推荐系统作为唯一可接受的用途；“not all of the data”的范围与“only recommendations”的限制都在目标中保留，未扩写为彻底不采集。

G017.target_statement: Give me all information relevant to my interests in a short time, without a lot of content, in a news aggregation view.
G017.label: direct
G017.rationale: 原文在被问“如何衡量聚合功能成功”时直接给出标准：量不多、但与兴趣相关的信息要全、且时间短；作为成功标准保留，未补阈值。
